comments: Since the post-colophon annotation also mentions as source the instance belonging to sKyo ston (ID:4052) and Chos kyi rgyal mtshan (ID:6458) as scribe, we take it to re-iterate the information of the colophon with the addition of a place of copy, rather than hinting at a subsequent copy.
